en.authority: Finlex / Ministry of Justice of Finland
en.text: Article 10 — Dividends. The current Finlex synthesised text of the Finland–Czech Republic tax treaty provides a 5 per cent source-State ceiling where the beneficial owner is a company, other than a partnership, directly holding at least 25 per cent of the capital of the payer, and a 15 per cent ceiling in all other cases. The permanent-establishment effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise synthesis of the current official Finlex treaty text; that text controls.

en.authority: Finlex / Ministry of Justice of Finland
en.text: Article 11 — Interest. The current Finlex synthesised text of the Finland–Czech Republic tax treaty provides residence-State-only taxation for interest beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State, subject to the permanent-establishment effective-connection exception and the treaty’s arm’s-length limitation. This is a concise synthesis of the current official Finlex treaty text; that text controls.

en.authority: Finlex / Ministry of Justice of Finland
en.text: Article 12 — Royalties. The current Finlex synthesised text of the Finland–Czech Republic tax treaty provides differentiated source-State ceilings for royalties beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State: 0 per cent for copyright royalties including films and broadcast media; 1 per cent for a financial lease of equipment; 5 per cent for an operating lease of equipment or computer software; and 10 per cent for patents, trademarks, designs or models, plans, secret formulae or processes and industrial, commercial or scientific know-how. The permanent-establishment effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise synthesis of the current official Finlex treaty text; that text controls.
